instruction:
Produce a concise, read-only engineering assessment of the exact pinned alexwelcing/lupine-rhizo repository revision. Exactly one orchestrator and one worker. This is not scientific validation or publication approval.

Execution contract: 16 model calls TOTAL, split master at most 6 and worker at most 10. The master has at most 3 calls before a real ready worker report; reserve its other calls for review/closing. Exploration tools stop after GLOBAL call 8. Every tool result includes a fixed codingBudget snapshot; use it. Batch tree listing and selected source reads into a few bash calls, with output bounded by 64 KiB. Read AGENTS.md and README first. Do not spend calls inspecting this recipe or tool internals unless needed for the assessment. No extra worker, model, retry, or budget extension.

Worker: target 800–1200 words across the structured report. By GLOBAL call 9 use assessment_write with the exact targetRevision, status complete-source-review only if all eight domains have real inspected source evidence (otherwise incomplete), summary, inspectedPaths, eight domains, three priorities, exclusions, and limitations. assessment_write creates both JSON and Markdown at the fixed artifact paths; do not write them through bash. Use short concrete findings, path citations, and one limitation per domain. Next call orchestrator_report state ready only after the writer succeeds and all domains are source-observed; otherwise report blocked with the incomplete limits. Do not use further exploration during finalization. The main agent must then read the report and close the ready result through the existing orchestrator workflow. Budget reservation is not a guarantee of report quality.

Eight exact domain IDs: orchestration; discovery-knowledge; library-provenance; scientific-compute; formal-evidence; build-deploy; evaluation-measurement; researcher-experience. Cover durable agent ownership, Line/discovery/graph, Library/provenance, numerical compute including LAMMPS/MLIPs, formal proof/evidence gates, build/deployment, evaluation/measurement, and researcher experience/taxonomy. Each domain needs status source-observed or uninspected, finding, paths, limitation. Each priority needs title, evidencePaths, proposal, failureTest, recoveryTest. These tests are proposals: do not claim to have executed them.

The worker must distinguish source observation from unverified runtime behavior and proposed changes. Existing path validation does not prove a path was read. Cite only inspected paths. Do not claim whole-repository coverage. Preserve negative and missing evidence. No tracked source edits, package installs, external research, extra model calls, credentials, deployment, publishing, messages to people, scheduled tasks, or scientific simulation. Native bash is authorized only for bounded local source inspection; commands at most 30 seconds, no background processes. The local result channel is internal, not verified external delivery. Human/independent review of the generated assessment is pending. The deliverables are .lupine-coding-evidence/repository-assessment.json and .lupine-coding-evidence/repository-assessment.md. Do not manufacture a ready report if they are missing or incomplete.
